entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Vicious reddish green elder dragon, mother of the Primeval Rith, put to sleep after the battle at Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Progenitor who spawned the elder dragons.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who instigated the Elder Dragon War.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Elder dragon, twin of Nicol, brother of Palladia-Mors.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: Benevolent elder dragon who lived in disguise as the boy Ham and put Palladia-Mors to sleep.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: Elder dragon cousin cursed into a dragon whelp who manipulated Red Donald.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: War among elder dragons instigated by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Mors Ridge
entities.description: Dominarian town where Palladia-Mors was buried and later awakened.

entities.name: Arcus
entities.description: Member of the High Council of Mors Ridge who tells the legend each year.

entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: Warlord killed by the awakened dragons.

entities.name: Ad'Amra
entities.description: Daughter of Red Donald who leads the Army of the Valley and loves Ham.

entities.name: Army of the Valley
entities.description: Force fighting the dragons at Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Tickery Man
entities.description: Title of the keeper of the sleep magic at Mors Ridge.

events.summary: Palladia-Mors, impressionable, joins the Elder Dragon War as instigated by Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: one of the first to partake in the Elder Dragon War

events.summary: In the legend, Palladia-Mors destroys Mors Ridge's townsfolk until a stranger casts a spell that brings her down; she is buried.
events.quote: Palladia-Mors shrieked a battle cry and flew off to destroy the humans.

events.summary: Red Donald digs canals at the urging of his whelp familiar, awakening Palladia-Mors.
Palladia and Vaevictis wreak havoc with an army of zombies and orcs and kill Red Donald; Ad'Amra takes the lead of the Army of the Valley.
Ham is revealed to be Chromium Rhuell; Vaevictis disappears from the battle and Ad'Amra and Chromium put the sleep spell back on Palladia.
events.quote: Ham was the benevolent Elder Dragon Chromium Rhuell

relations.quote: She was spawned by the Ur-Dragon
She is the mother of the Primeval Rith
